Questions for you

85

The 12 weeks sheet still says “As in the tables”. Change those words?

The print tables are gone, so “the tables” no longer points anywhere. The words come from the plan data and the approved mock-up, so I did not change them on my own.

  1. a) Change to “Sets as shown on each day” (only the words change, not the plan)
  2. b) Keep “As in the tables”

Recommended: a, because the words should point at something you can see in the app.

Marked on: The 12 weeks, built, light and dark

86

On Friday, should the “Monday ›” arrow open next week’s Monday?

I built it that way after the auditor found the old arrow went back to this week’s Monday. The page then says “Showing week 4. This week is week 3.” with “Back to this week”. Only at the very start and end of the 12 weeks do the arrows stay in the same week.

  1. a) Yes, keep it: the arrows move into the next or previous week
  2. b) No: the arrows always stay inside the shown week

Recommended: a, because the day after Friday is next week’s Monday, so the arrow reads like a calendar.

Marked on: Monday after the plan change, built, light and dark (the “‹ Friday” arrow opens last week’s Friday)
